# An exact three-carrier permutation-memory receiver

30 October 2026. C construction. Native fresh memoryless flat encoding;
no inverse, source environment, microscopic label or controlled source.
This supplies an exact all-order dynamics/readout interface for specified
controllers. It does not assert a high-fidelity scalable inverse.

## 1. State representation, including correlations

Let N_U(X)=U(X tensor I_r/r)U*, U:C^k tensor C^r -> C^D, D>=kr.
Three live physical carriers have logical factors L0,L1,L2 and junk
J0,J1,J2 in the common unknown input frame. E is known retained memory;
an arbitrary inaccessible reference can be included as a spectator.
Use the convention

    P_g |x0,...,x(n-1)> = |x_(g^-1(0)),...,x_(g^-1(n-1))>,
    P_g P_h=P_(g h).

Starting with fresh independent junk and using only known physical
permutations controlled by known memory, the EXACT live state has form

    rho = r^-3 sum_(pi in S3) X_pi tensor P_pi^J.          (1)

X_pi acts on (L0,L1,L2,E), and can be nonpositive/non-Hermitian. The
convenient Hermitian coefficient choice is X_(pi^-1)=X_pi*. No independence
between junk and logical/reference memory is imposed by (1). It contains
precisely the permutation-valued correlations omitted by a marginal-only
description. At r>=3 the six permutation matrices are linearly independent;
at r=1,2 the same formula remains valid with its physical representation
quotient. We retain formal coefficients instead of treating null relations
as an extra source resource.

The trace is

    Tr rho = sum_pi r^[cycles(pi)-3] Tr X_pi.              (2)

Individual X_pi are not density matrices and their traces are not classical
path probabilities. Positivity always means positivity of the physical
operator in (1), obtained by the literal circuit below.

## 2. One new native call, arbitrary controlled-permutation stages

Append the fourth fresh junk I_r/r. A known memory/source-input circuit,
with any paid permutation-control stages on the four physical wires,

# Completed three-carrier construction boundary

The exact live state is r^-3 sum_(pi in S3) X_pi tensor P_pi. Appending
fresh junk and tracing one old programme has a closed S4-to-S3 rule:
delete the old wire from the permutation; the coefficient is1 when it
was fixed and1/r otherwise, with the SAME logical partial trace and
survivor ordering. Every surviving permutation has exactly four
predecessors, one unattenuated and three weighted1/r.

This supplies an exact all-order receiver for any specified normalized
known controlled-permutation circuit, including growing reference
memory. With fixed known memory it is a finite transfer on at most six
operator coefficients; a literal final S3-group readout gives a finite
known6M-dimensional decoder interface. No final exponential-history
oracle or unknown inverse is supplied.

For pre-query S3 controls the immediate post-cell state simplifies even
further: the new junk is an independent I/r, leaving only identity and
the SWAP of the two surviving old carriers at that cut. This surviving
nontrivial coefficient must not be reset away.

The exact two-round controlled-SWAP echo exhibits a genuine O(1)
reversible coherence mode. Its junk marginal is maximally mixed at all
times, yet replacing correlations by an independent state changes final
flag visibility from1 to1/r^2. All target/programme matrix units and
rank dependence were checked symbolically, not on a chosen rank or an
optimised low-query source fixture.

The single stdlib compilation took0.05311s after imports. Its table,
readout orientation, finite representations and complete echo checks
are recorded in ALGEBRA_RECEIPT.json. No source or quantum circuit ran.

The echo is an interference-memory control, not a useful inverse:
doing nothing restores that physical input more cheaply. Its consequence
is that the ROOT28 spent-carrier scalar barrier cannot be imported into
this retained physical-history class. Root's central next operation must
convert these preserved correlations into a high-fidelity known logical
output. General near-linear-r approximate recovery remains OPEN.
